title: macos: fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions
scenario: On macos, a hard operational problem: Le sessioni via bastion cadono dopo qualche minuto di inattivita'. Diagnostica keepalive/timeout lungo la catena e rendi le sessioni stabili. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions

initial_state: # fixture: macos host prepared for 'fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions'
expected_reasoning: Idle-drop points at a keepalive/timeout somewhere in the chain (client, bastion, target, or a NAT).
Identify which hop times out (NAT idle, ClientAlive, firewall) via the drop pattern.
Set keepalives at the right layer; don't just crank one side.
expected_commands: # macos-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: fix a bastion/jump-host chain that drops long sessions

possible_mistakes: Blame the target when a NAT idle timeout is the cause.
Set an aggressive keepalive that hides the real timeout.
hints: The drop interval hints at which timeout fires.
ServerAlive/ClientAlive vs NAT idle are different layers.
reference_solution: Identify the timing/hop of the drop
Set keepalive at the right layer
Verify a long idle session survives
alternative_solution: Use a session multiplexer (mosh/tmux) so a drop doesn't lose work.
edge_cases: A corporate NAT with a short UDP/TCP idle is the hidden culprit.
goal: Le sessioni via bastion cadono dopo qualche minuto di inattivita'. Diagnostica keepalive/timeout lungo la catena e rendi le sessioni stabili.
